content.short: Boxo is a mini-app platform that adds eSIMs, bill payments, travel and more to any app.
content.description: Boxo helps apps become super apps by plugging in ready-made services such as eSIMs, marketplaces, bill payments, remittance, insurance and travel booking. It powers the eSIM mini app inside World App, which is listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Boxo is a super-app platform whose eSIM service runs as a mini app in World App.
